payload.claim: K3: components that compute the odds of the decision token, validated in the real model
payload.node_set: 36 x 32 heads (o_proj input slice) + 36 MLP outputs at COND / SPEC / OPEN / DEC = 4,752 nodes

metrics.C1: m = z(' Kr') - z(' Prim') at DEC (last of B3's 61-token opening)
metrics.C2a: m = z(' find') - z(' dfs') at DEC (' def', token 10 of the T10 prefix)
metrics.C2b: m' = z(' find') - logsumexp(z(' dfs'), z(' bfs'))

payload.pair_rule: C1-nat: 24 neutral-noun variants per template W1-W5; within template the k-th highest m (clean) with the k-th lowest (corrupt): set A k = 1..3, set B k = 4..6; held-out H 2 per template (seed 8301, one above and one below the template median); pairs with TE <= 0.2 dropped; < 10 surviving pairs or mean TE(A) < 1.0 nat -> F2 (C1-forced primary)
payload.screen: AtP noising (grad at clean x (corrupt - clean)); top 60 by |mean AtP|; reliability: exact noising of 40 random nodes per class (seed 8304); Spearman < 0.6 -> IG-AtP (5 alphas) and 120 exact nodes
payload.exact: noising and denoising of the top 60 + 20 random calibration nodes (seed 8305); ranking by |mean noising effect| (Gemma's rule)
payload.edges: path patching among the top 15; keep |mean| >= 0.05 x mean TE
payload.faithfulness: k in {5,10,15,30,60}: clean input, non-circuit nodes frozen to corrupt values (type 1) or to the corrupt-class same-template mean (type 2), circuit nodes live; completeness (top-k noised) and sufficiency (top-k denoised)
payload.random_matching: heads: +-10/25/50% write norm (>= 50 candidates), 50 without replacement; MLPs: +-10/25/50%/nearest-10 (>= 10 distinct), 50 with replacement, delta rescaled to the target's write norm; seed 8302
payload.validation: ABLATE node <- opposite-class mean; STEER node <- own + 2 x (opposite mean - own mean); oriented dm vs in-chunk base; d_i = dm_node - mean dm_rand; one-sided sign-flip (exact n <= 25 else 1e6 MC); PRIMARY Holm over all 20 node x test p; NODE PASS = Holm p < 0.05 in both tests; Gemma's within-test Holm reported beside
payload.time_rule: if the first-prompt timing extrapolates validation of one contrast beyond 45 min, V = 15 clean + 10 H; beyond that H drops to 5; random count never reduced (C1-nat)
payload.generation: arms TWIN, TOP5 (STEER toward the minority on all five), RAND5 (frozen matched five, seed 8303); N = 30 = W1-W5 x 6 CRN slots; T 1, top-p 1, no top-k, max_new 1024; PRIMARY = PREFILL (prompt + opening prefilled for every arm); SECONDARY = FREE (OPEN/DEC edits fire only while the generated prefix equals the opening); targets B3 correct prim_heap/prim_array, T10 correct dfs
payload.gen_criteria: TOP5 - TWIN correct-target >= 6; exact McNemar TOP5 vs RAND5 p < 0.05; pass(TOP5) >= 0.8 x pass(TWIN)
payload.K3_verdict: PASS = C1: >= 5 of 10 nodes pass both tests AND PREFILL top-5 meets all three generation criteria; PARTIAL = exactly one; DISCONFIRMED = no top-10 node passes either test; C2a reported with the same rule; the C1 McNemar p enters the paper's primary Holm family

predictions.P1: >= 5 of 10 nodes pass both tests on C1-nat
predictions.P2: PREFILL top-5 steering: TWIN + >= 6 correct Prim of 30, beats RAND5 (McNemar p < 0.05), pass >= 0.8 x twin
predictions.P3: the same on C2a toward DFS
predictions.P4: motif: DEC share in [0.38, 0.68], COND share in [0.21, 0.51], DEC-position stack effect-weighted depth in [0.45, 0.80]
predictions.P5: top-10 Jaccard between pair sets A and B >= 0.4

payload.motif_function: share(c) = sum over the exact list (top 40 by |AtP| + 20 random calibration nodes, Gemma's composition) in class c of |mean noising effect| / total; validated on Gemma's g1_pathpatch.json (FORK 0.531, COND 0.357) before any Qwen value
never_drop: C1 screen + exact + path patching + matched-random validation + PREFILL top-5 generation
